chunks: Tamīm ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn Tamīm, al-Qarashī. The one from whom Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn Bābawayh narrated.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَابَوَيْه: Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn Bābawayh, a prominent Shia scholar and narrator
key_terms.الْقُرَشِيُّ: al-Qarashī, indicating his tribal lineage from Quraysh
key_terms.تَمِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Tamīm ibn ʿAbdullāh, the narrator's name
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak, a technical term in hadith sciences indicating a narrator's reliability is not strong

ai.seo_question: Who is Tamīm ibn ʿAbdullāh ibn Tamīm and what is his status as a narrator in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry identifies Tamīm ibn āʿAbdullāh ibn Tamīm, al-Qarashī, as a narrator from whom Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn Bābawayh (Ibn Bābawayh) transmitted hadith. He is classified as 'weak' (daʿīf) in terms of his reliability in transmitting narrations.
